home.tagline: University residence management platform: bills, payments, communication and community life.

nav.confirmLogout: Log out? Anything being typed will be lost.

credentials.title: Change my credentials
credentials.subtitle: To secure your account, choose your own username and a new password (minimum 8 characters).
credentials.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
credentials.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

home.title: Dashboard
home.creerFactureDesc: Enter a monthly bill, adjust coefficients, then publish.
home.gererUsersDesc: Create landlord and tenant accounts, deactivate accounts.

users.title: Users
users.createdHint: Hand over these temporary credentials in person (shown only once):
users.deactivateFailed: The account could not be deactivated.

factures.title: Bills

new.title: New bill
new.hint: The bill is created as a draft: all active tenants are attached with a coefficient of 1, adjustable before publishing.
new.hintLoyer: Rent: no split. The amount entered is owed by each active tenant for the year. After every recorded payment, the tenant, the Admin and the Landlord see the amount paid this month, the yearly total and the remaining balance.
new.confirmCreate: Create this invoice? It starts as a draft: amounts and deadline stay correctable until it is published.

detail.confirmPublish: Publish this bill? Coefficients will no longer be editable and tenants will see it.
detail.loyerNoCoeff: Rent: identical annual amount per tenant, no coefficient.
detail.editHint: Only a draft can be edited. Once published, the invoice becomes an accounting document.
detail.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this draft? This cannot be undone.
detail.confirmCoeffs: Save these coefficients? The split of the total between tenants will be recomputed.
detail.confirmEdit: Save these corrections? They are no longer possible once the invoice is published.
detail.published: Invoice published: the tenants can now see it.
detail.deleteHint: To confirm, type the invoice's month ({mois}).
detail.confirmPrint: Produce {name}'s invoice? The document carries their personal data.

factures.exportTronque: Export capped at the first {max} lines: the file and its totals are partial. Filter by month for a complete statement.
factures.confirmExport: Export the published invoices for the selected period? The file will contain named personal data.

compteurs.title: Meters
compteurs.purpose: Meters are what water and electricity bills are raised against: attach one to the bill, and record its reading at each billing.
compteurs.deleteBloque: Meter attached to a bill or a room: it cannot be deleted.
compteurs.aucunCompteur: No meter recorded yet: add one from the Meters page.

paiement.motifPlaceholder: e.g. amount recorded against the wrong tenant
paiement.confirmAnnulation: Cancel this {montant} payment? The line balance will be recomputed and the receipt will no longer be available.
paiement.motifTropCourt: Give a reason of at least 5 characters.
paiement.confirmEncaisser: Take {montant}? A payment is never edited: afterwards it can only be cancelled, with a reason.
paiement.annulationDone: Payment cancelled; the balance has been recomputed.

locataire.title: My bills
locataire.documentFr: Official document issued in French, whatever the language of the app.

dashboard.loyerHint: Rent is a yearly flat amount: it is tracked apart from monthly charges.

annonces.title: Post an announcement
annonces.confirmSend: Send this announcement? A notification goes out to every recipient at once and cannot be recalled.

suggestions.title: Suggestion box
suggestions.hint: Your suggestion is sent to the administration. You will be notified once it is reviewed.
suggestions.placeholder: Your idea to improve life in the residence…
suggestions.myEmpty: You have not submitted any suggestions yet.
suggestions.author: By {name}
suggestions.confirmPublish: Make this suggestion visible to the landlord? Its author will be named on it.
suggestions.confirmHide: Hide this suggestion from the landlord?
suggestions.published: Suggestion now visible to the landlord.
suggestions.visibilityFailed: The visibility could not be changed.
suggestions.readFailed: The suggestion could not be marked as read.

evenements.title: Events
evenements.hint: Propose an event; the administration approves it before publication.
evenements.confirmApprove: Approve “{titre}”? The event becomes visible to every resident.
evenements.confirmReject: Reject “{titre}”? Its author will be told.
evenements.decisionFailed: The decision could not be recorded.

profil.title: My profile
profil.birthdayHint: If enabled, a 7-day reminder is sent to the community (opt-in).
profil.birthdayYearOptional: Leave the year empty to keep your age private.

distress.label: Distress signal
distress.geoPrompt: Signal sent. Also share your location to help responders find you?
distress.confirmResolve: Close this alert? Its sender will be recorded as attended to.
distress.confirmBan: Remove {name}'s access to the alert button? They will no longer be able to raise an alarm.
distress.confirmUnban: Give {name} back access to the alert button?
distress.resolveFailed: The alert could not be closed.
distress.banFailed: The access could not be changed.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.hint: Report a non-urgent issue (plumbing, electricity, furniture…).
maintenance.statutFailed: The status could not be changed.

sondages.title: Polls
sondages.question: Question
sondages.confirmClose: Close this poll? No further votes will be accepted and closing is final.
sondages.voteFailed: The vote could not be recorded.
sondages.closeFailed: The poll could not be closed.

portfolio.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Shown as a circle in the directory.
portfolio.confirmDelete: Remove your portfolio from the directory? Your account stays active and you can recreate it.

projets.title: Shared projects
projets.confirmContribuer: Confirm a contribution of {montant} to “{titre}”? It will be recorded in your name.
projets.contribuerFailed: The contribution could not be recorded.

predictions.title: Charge estimates
predictions.purpose: Helping you prepare next month's payment ahead of time.
predictions.purposeLocataire: The estimate shows the upcoming charge for the whole residence, then what you personally will have to pay: start setting the amount aside now.
predictions.purposeGestion: Published to everyone, the estimate shows the upcoming charge for the whole residence and the share owed by each tenant.
predictions.repartitionHint: Share computed by splitting the total equally between the {count} active tenants.
predictions.confirmSaveReel: Record {montant} as the actual amount? The forecast's variance will be recomputed.
predictions.saveReelFailed: The actual amount could not be recorded.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twofa.desc: Add a one-time code (TOTP) to your admin sign-in.
twofa.scanHint: Add this key to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis…), then enter the generated code.
twofa.confirmDisable: Disable two-factor authentication? The account will then be protected by its password alone.

posts.title: News feed
posts.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP — 5 MB max
posts.confirmHide: Hide “{titre}”? The post leaves the residents' feed.
posts.confirmShow: Show “{titre}” in the residents' feed again?
posts.moderationFailed: The post could not be changed.

documents.title: Documents
documents.deleteFailed: The document could not be deleted.

common.downloadFailed: The document could not be produced.

auth.tokenManquant: No session: please sign in again.
auth.tokenInvalide: Session expired: please sign in again.
auth.roleRefuse: Your role does not grant access to this action.

auth.sessionRevoquee: Session revoked: please sign in again.
auth.profilRefuse: Access to this profile is denied.

user.adminNonDesactivable: An admin account cannot be deactivated.

facture.publieeNonModifiable: Bill already published: it can no longer be edited.
facture.publieeNonSupprimable: Bill already published: it can no longer be deleted.
facture.nonPublieeDocument: Bill not published: the document is unavailable.
facture.aucunLocataireActif: No active tenant on this bill.
facture.aucunLocataireRattacher: No active tenant to attach to the bill.
facture.locatairesInconnus: {count, plural, one {# selected tenant is unknown or deactivated} other {# selected tenants are unknown or deactivated}}; the bill was not created.
facture.locatairesNonRattaches: {count, plural, one {# tenant is not attached} other {# tenants are not attached}} to this bill.
facture.loyerAnneeOccupee: A rent bill already covers {annee} ({mois}). Rent is a flat annual amount: correct the existing bill rather than creating a second one.
facture.loyerMontantAnnuelRequis: Rent bill: enter the annual amount owed by each tenant.
facture.loyerMontantTotalInterdit: Rent bill: the flat amount is corrected through the annual amount per tenant, not through a total.
facture.loyerSansCoefficient: Rent bill: identical annual amount per tenant, with no split and no coefficient.
facture.loyerEcheanceTropTot: Rent bill: the flat amount covers a year, so the deadline must be at least {mois} months after the start of the period.
facture.loyerEntree: Switching to rent: enter the annual amount owed by each tenant.
facture.loyerSortie: Leaving the rent regime: enter the total amount to split.
facture.montantParLocataireReserveLoyer: The per-tenant amount is reserved for rent; other bills are split from a total amount.
facture.echeanceHorsPeriode: The deadline no longer falls within the billed period: adjust the due date as well.
facture.doublonTypeMois: A bill of this type already exists for this period.
facture.doublonLoyerAnnee: A rent bill already exists for this year.

paiement.factureNonPubliee: Cannot record a payment: the bill is not published.
paiement.montantDepasseSolde: The amount exceeds the remaining balance ({reste, number} XAF).
paiement.encaissementConcurrent: Another payment has just been recorded on this line. Reload the bill and check the remaining balance.

compteur.libelleDuplique: A meter “{libelle}” already exists for this type.
compteur.utilise: Meter in use: {factures, plural, one {# bill} other {# bills}} and {chambres, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} are attached to it.

evenement.dejaTraite: This event has already been handled.

projet.inaccessible: This project is not accessible to you.

notification.accesRefuse: Access to this notification is denied.
notification.aucunDestinataire: No active recipient for this scope.

distress.banni: Your access to the distress signal has been suspended by the administration.

upload.stockageNonConfigure: Storage unavailable: please contact the administration.
upload.contenuIncoherent: The file content does not match its declared type.

calcul.aucunLocataire: No tenant attached to the bill.
calcul.montantTotalInvalide: The total amount must be a positive integer (XAF, no cents).
calcul.sommeCoeffInvalide: The sum of the coefficients must be strictly positive.

validation.telephoneInvalide: Invalid phone number (6 to 20 characters, digits and separators).
validation.moisFormat: Month expected in YYYY-MM format (01 to 12).
validation.montantXor: Enter either the total amount or the per-tenant amount.
validation.dateLimiteHorsPeriode: The deadline must fall between the first day of the billed month and {mois} months later.
validation.dateLimiteLoyer: Rent bill: the flat amount covers a year, so the deadline must be at least {mois} months after the start of the period (31 December, for instance).

generic.tropDeRequetes: Too many requests. Try again in {secondes} s.
generic.referenceInexistante: The request references something that does not exist.
